topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the cancer biology lecture series and outlines the core learning outcomes for the session.

topics.label: Cancer pathogenesis, tissue architecture, and study models
topics.groupedBecause: They explain cancer as a progressive failure of cellular differentiation and tissue architecture driven by genetic changes, alongside the models used to study these processes.

topics.label: Tumor invasion, metastasis, and malignancy criteria
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the physical, histological, and anatomical features of invasion and metastatic spread that distinguish malignant tumors from benign ones.

topics.label: Stepwise tumor progression and clinical risks of benign lesions
topics.groupedBecause: They illustrate the stepwise progression from benign adenomas to invasive carcinomas and examine the clinical complications that non-invasive tumors can produce.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature conventions and exceptions
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the systematic naming conventions used for benign and malignant neoplasms across tissue types along with key exceptions.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: It details the physical, metabolic, and metastatic mechanisms through which tumors cause clinical illness and patient death.

topics.label: Tumor incidence across human tissues and animal species
topics.groupedBecause: They analyze the frequency and mortality patterns of different tumor types in humans as well as cancer occurrence across other multicellular animals.

topics.label: Cancer screening principles and organ-specific modalities
topics.groupedBecause: They evaluate the rationale for population-level cancer screening, contrasting successful modalities such as cervical cytology with more challenging screening approaches in other organs.

topics.label: Conclusion and upcoming practical reminders
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture with a reminder of the learning outcomes and housekeeping details for practical sessions.
